title: M11 Wave 4: c1/14-17 flip the card, counting with lamps, inside the number, make-your-own-instruction, with G5
description: Part of M11 (SIE-e8c918). c1/14-16 are the old draft lessons 06-08, renamed in the product repo. c1/17 encodes a word with lamps (D4 word target). Engine: G5. Overflow appears here as a planned surprise (side room).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope change from the educator review. Source: docs/reviews/2026-10-07-educator-review.md; follow-up epic SIE-2f17ee. Wave 4 is now the binary lessons moved after the functions: lamps BEFORE flip (counting with lamps first, then flip with a number-only lens, then inside the number with bands and no hex), Run label kept in all lessons, one new control per lesson (SIE-1f09cb R4). Add algebra line 'each lamp is a power of 2' (R5, SIE-abddd5), hidden labels for place questions (R2), honest lamps claim (R8, SIE-0da803). G5 is SIE-5f0afe.
